messages:
Priya: Quick sync — want to lock microtiming for the marketplace launch next Thu. Proposal: landing cutover 09:00 PT, press release 09:05 PT, blog publish 09:15 PT, partner comms at 09:30 PT. Any objections?
Liam: fine with that. prefer press at :05 to give embargo lift buffer. can ops delay ingestions until +10m?
Noah: we can hold non-critical onboarding tasks to +15m. core tenant provisioning needs to be live by 09:00.
Ava: marketing ready for 09:05 press. want a 5m heads-up from infra before cutover to trigger social posts. @Priya pls confirm.
Priya: yes I can send a 5m heads-up. also need to confirm hardware partner banner (ApexEdge) sizing on the landing — Marta can you confirm?
Marta: ApexEdge signed off on hero 1200x400, they asked for dark-mode asset. uploading to /assets/partners/apexedge/ now.
Liam: can you tag the SKU string? we need exact marketplace listing ID for the press copy.
Marta: listing id is mkp-APX-2025. adding to the shared doc.
Priya: SI integrations: two partners (IntegralSI, AtlasWorks) need pre-warm access. Noah can you confirm service account provisioning and test endpoints?
Noah: provisioning queued. test endpoints ready by 08:20 PT. will run smoke and KV-cache warm sweep at 08:30.
Priya: perfect. small ask on press: avoid naming specific customer references until legal clears. Liam, can you keep the press copy generic and push a beta customer quote only if legal OKs by EOD?
Liam: will do. legal pinged earlier. if we don't get approval, we run with product-focused quote.
Ava: blog plan — short lead, 3 partner callouts, one technical sidebar about latency improvements. need final draft by EOD for review.
Priya: drafting partner callouts now. adding a micro-timeline at bottom for customers (what to expect minute-by-minute).
Noah: ops note: autoscale ramp configured, but we should set a temporary throughput cap for first 30m to avoid noisy neighbor spikes. Suggest 120% baseline for first 30m.
Marta: on hardware side, monitoring will send telemetry to partner portal. confirm that partner portal webhook is in prod config?
Noah: webhook endpoint is live, auth token rotated this morning.
Priya: deploy-bot, can you create a one-off channel topic and post the runbook link when we flip to launch?
deploy-bot: Created channel topic and pinned runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marketplace-launch-microtiming
calendar-bot: Reminder set: "Marketplace launch microtiming — final preflight" at 08:00 PT on Thu.
Ava: tiny nit — add a short “what to say” bullet for support in the runbook so CS doesn't improvise.
Priya: good call. adding three canned responses for common questions: pricing, onboarding timeline, and data residency.
Liam: final ask — press pickup window: target tech outlets at 09:05, general biz outlets at 09:20. feeding embargo list now.
Marta: hardware partners will stand by on the live page at 09:00 in case we need to swap hero assets.
Priya: final checklist (small):
```
- 08:00 PT preflight (all teams) — confirm smoke ✅
- 08:20 PT SI test endpoints ✅
- 08:30 PT KV warm sweep ✅
- 09:00 PT landing cutover (noon UTC) ✅
- 09:05 PT press release publish ✅
- 09:10 PT social go (5m after press) ✅
- 09:15 PT long-form blog publish ✅
- 09:30 PT partner outbound email ✅
```
Priya: please react with :thumbsup: when you’re aligned, or flag blockers now.
Liam: :thumbsup:
Noah: :thumbsup:
Ava: :thumbsup:
Marta: :thumbsup:
Priya: thanks — I'll post the final minute-by-minute runbook here an hour before launch.
